decisions.title: Market Data Provider Selection
decisions.scientific_and_governance_summary: Evaluation of candidate feeds (Tiingo, Alpaca, Massive, IBKR). Tiingo Power ($30/mo) is recommended for historical/offline daily EOD bars; Alpaca AlgoTrader Plus ($9/mo) is recommended for broker simulated paper orders. Massive is disqualified under default terms.
decisions.owner_action_required: Formally select primary market-data vendor for prospective daily bars.

decisions.title: Market Data Licensing and Rights
decisions.scientific_and_governance_summary: All 4 providers enforce non-display restrictions and mandatory post-termination data purge clauses. Tiingo Starter prohibits persistent storage of derived products; Massive Developer prohibits non-display algorithmic usage.
decisions.owner_action_required: Execute required commercial addenda (e.g. Tiingo Power active subscription + non-display addendum / Alpaca paper API agreement) and approve fail-closed data purge architecture.

decisions.title: Statistical Endpoint and Inferential Protocol
decisions.scientific_and_governance_summary: Two-tier hypothesis structure (H01 directional downside reduction, H02 10-bps economic hurdle) with conservative disjunction rule. Size calibration shows empirical inflation (7.7% - 8.9%) at N=30.
decisions.owner_action_required: Review and ratify two-tier inferential protocol and acknowledge underpowered classification if N_def < 60.

sub_decisions.title: Causal Session Eligibility
sub_decisions.summary: Eligible sessions defined strictly ex-ante by S_{T-1} == DEFENSIVE. Collider conditioning on R_{m,T} < 0 is formally relegated to secondary sub-analysis.

sub_decisions.title: Statistical Size Calibration
sub_decisions.summary: Dual HAC + Bootstrap joint test rejects 7.7% - 8.9% at N=30 under the null boundary (nominal 5%), failing size calibration in small samples.

sub_decisions.title: Secondary Return Constraint
sub_decisions.summary: Delta CAGR >= -200 bps secondary guardrail against excessive cash drag.

decisions.title: Evaluation Horizon and Stopping Rules
decisions.scientific_and_governance_summary: Inverse sampling quota design requiring N_def >= 30 causal risk-off sessions over an initial 252 sessions (extendable to 504 sessions). Zero return or p-value peeking permitted.
decisions.owner_action_required: Approve evaluation duration budget and formal trial conclusion criteria.

sub_decisions.title: Sampling Quota Floor
sub_decisions.summary: Minimum causal defensive sample count N_def >= 30.

sub_decisions.title: Administrative Extension
sub_decisions.summary: Extension up to 504 trading days governed solely by pre-declared session counts.

decisions.title: Monitoring and Incident Governance
decisions.scientific_and_governance_summary: Fail-closed automated circuit breakers, slippage alerts, and state quarantine mechanisms mathematically specified and verified in synthetic unit tests.
decisions.owner_action_required: Approve incident response runbook and authorize offline network socket latency profiling.

sub_decisions.title: Fail-Closed Incident Lock
sub_decisions.summary: Tripwires defined for slippage > 50 bps, 3 missing bars, and weight divergence > 2%.

sub_decisions.title: Latency and Data Availability
sub_decisions.summary: Physical network latency profiling pending live connection authorization.

sub_decisions.title: Operator Recovery Controls
sub_decisions.summary: Runbook procedures for manual intervention and state reconciliation.

decisions.title: Activation Authority
decisions.scientific_and_governance_summary: Permanent safety boundary. Neither paper nor live trading execution can be initiated without explicit owner action. Zero autonomous agent activation authority.
decisions.owner_action_required: REMAINS BLOCKED. Do not authorize until DEC-01 through DEC-05 are fully resolved.
